name: Desco Electronics Inc
old_description: We're a UL-recognized and approved manufacturer of wire processing and harness processing. Rely on our knowledgeable and technical team to provide you with custom wire harnesses and cable sub-assemblies specific to your box build need.
about:
Desco Electronics Inc. has operated from Plainville, Massachusetts since 1971. The company is a second-generation, woman-owned business that began as a specialist in wire and cable harness manufacturing and has since expanded into full box-build assemblies.

The shop produces custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, flat-ribbon cables, and electromechanical control-panel builds. It also offers manufacturing engineering design, assembly consulting, and value-added services for complete box-build integration. Production includes calibrated machinery and custom test fixtures for 100% functional verification.

Desco serves customers requiring UL-recognized wire processing and harness processing for box-build applications. Its assemblies are used in a range of electronic systems, though specific industry sectors are not publicly detailed.

The company emphasizes quality checks at every production phase, RoHS compliance, and a commitment to reasonable cost and lasting partnerships built over more than four decades.
